description:
Hi! I'm based in Mexico City and interested in data analysis, data science, and software development. I work with Python, data processing, and visualization, and use AI-assisted tools to build software.

For Space Apps, I'm designing GAIA, a web platform to explore environmental trends using NASA data and statistical analysis. I'll contribute to requirements, data analysis, and implementation.

I value teamwork, curiosity, and building something useful and scientifically sound.
